title: Inherited auth continuation, model preparation, snapshot maintenance and private secret fixtures; fixed identity writes, super-reset and model maintenance; frozen fivekeys/completion and local profile migration
description: Frozen model_control.rs DTOs use HostModelParams and ModelPreparation. x-methods selects decoded args/result validation. Selection SHA-256 is opaque: fixtures bind request to response, never claim authoritative recomputation or native execution. Profile and legacy recovery contexts are fixture-only evidence anchors, not grants, journals, or proof of native filesystem exclusion. Recovery methods prohibit operation fields even when legacy recovery has local effects.
